1.21.1.3.1.0.121012: Requires MMDLib 2.0.2 and Power Advantage 3.2. The Electric Oven, Electric Still and Petro-Plastic Refinery are MMDLib machines with MMDLib's standard screens: they no longer push their outputs out on their own, so install the new Item Output Port or Power Advantage's Fluid Output Pump, and a redstone signal only stops them on faces set to read it. The still runs every Power Advantage distilling recipe. Existing worlds keep machine contents; the still's output tank and buffered energy in those three are not kept.
